kind: Read-only production call-path and protocol inspection; not a runtime measurement
correction: The three original Source channels are not uniformly limited to 128 exchanges. A source visit count above 128 alone does not demonstrate a protocol failure. Existing fixed peer, pidfd, absolute expiry, complete-frame deadline and frame bound remain unchanged.

custody_path.move: material_source is consumed by OriginalCellQ24MaterialSourceConnectionV1::bind_original_dataset; that client and the original experience/dataset clients move into OriginalCellQ24RemoteTrainingSourceOwnersV1, then capture_original_remote_cell_q24_training_source_v1.
custody_path.live: cell_q24_training_source.rs::LiveOwners::read_original_evidence uses the same two LearningIterationEvidenceClientV1 values; OriginalMaterialSource::Remote uses OriginalCellQ24RemoteMaterialClientV1::read_current.

channels.name: Source Experience evidence
channels.nonce: u64 checked_add per exchange; no explicit 128 cap in this client/server
channels.limits: Original pidfd/identity and absolute lifetime; at most 500 ms complete exchange deadline, at most 300 s original lifetime, 16 KiB frames.

channels.name: Source Dataset evidence
channels.nonce: u64 checked_add per exchange; no explicit 128 cap in this client/server
channels.limits: Same original transport constraints; independent original role-specific connection.

channels.name: Source Material
channels.nonce: u64 checked_add per exchange; no explicit 128 cap in this client/server
channels.limits: Same original transport constraints; one complete response frame, no Begin/Page/Finish or hidden paging fallback; actual serialized response size has not been measured.

transport: HostAuthorityPeerChannel and RootObservationStream contain no request counter/cap; they enforce held original descriptor, peer/lifetime, deadlines and frame bounds. Candidate/Training/Evaluator/Model/Selection/NextUse purpose-specific for128 caps must be counted separately.

read_quantities.candidate_transfer_frames: ceil(original signed head bytes / 2048) + 1 request-response exchanges, including terminal Finish; at most 17 pages, and last actual nonce <=128 on this separate Candidate connection.

transport_non_counter_128: The one literal 128 in RootObservationStream bounds /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id text; it is not an exchange counter.
